description: Searches open prediction markets on Polymarket (real money, USDC) and Manifold (play money) by keywords, with optional closing-date window and minimum volume. Each row: venue, question, outcomes with prices (implied probability), volume with its unit (USD or mana), liquidity, close time and link. Results alternate between venues; up to 50 rows. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

closeAfter.description: Only markets closing on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

closeBefore.description: Only markets closing on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

minVolume.description: Minimum volume in the venue's own unit (USD on Polymarket, mana on Manifold)

q.description: Search words, e.g. fed, election, bitcoin
